source.authoredBasis: Original exercise 992 has no figure and says only to draw a quadrilateral and measure every angle. This is a newly selected quadrilateral, not a reconstructed source drawing: A=(0,0), B=(5,0), C=(5,2), D=(7/(1+sqrt(3)),7*sqrt(3)/(1+sqrt(3))), ordered A-B-C-D. The numerical coordinates below are direct evaluations of this exact basis. If t=7/(1+sqrt(3)), then D=(t,sqrt(3)*t) and t+sqrt(3)*t=7, so CD has slope -1 and AD slope sqrt(3). The interior angles derived from the adjacent vectors at these specific vertices are A=60, B=90, C=135, D=75 degrees. The focused check.mjs independently measures all four using dot and cross products, checks the exact-coordinate evaluations, and checks the actual SVG screen transform for equal x/y scale. No deliberate false geometry is drawn. Coordinates and derived answers are internal provenance only, never visible labels.
